integrity: All analytic hypotheses and threshold equations are explicit; the independent checker script gives finite numerical/algebraic diagnostics, not an infinite proof. The full argument is in RESULT.md.
scientific_limitations: Linear spectral stability of an identical four-patch unidirectional-loss delayed logistic system only. No nonlinear branch stability, full global dynamics, or heterogeneity theorem. Literature priority is best knowledge and not independently certified.
title: A chiral-to-synchronous instability switch in a lossy four-patch delayed population ring
